entities.summary: Richard Serra was an American artist known for his large-scale abstract sculptures made for site-specific landscape, urban, and architectural settings, and whose work has been primarily associated with postminimalism. Described as "one of his era's greatest sculptors", Serra became notable for emphasizing the material qualities of his works and exploration of the relationship between the viewer, the work, and the site. Richard Serra was a authors & novelists from San Francisco (1938-11-02, San Francisco–2024-03-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Richard Serra's large-scale abstract sculptures significantly impacted modern and contemporary art, influencing postminimalism and site-specific landscape design. His work has been exhibited globally, with notable installations in cities like New York, Paris, and Tokyo.
